notes.title: NEW UPDATE - Death Cam, Skip that Dab and new environment
notes.content:
[b]New feature: helpful hints with the Death Cam[/b]
We’ve added this new hint feature that shows you know which character killed you whenever you fail a puzzle:a new cinematic camera that swoops in and frames your lifeless body and whoever shot you! Learn from it and try again! Check it out below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549081/2f6e0f722e5ea85f255cd48e2f91481ec1ed07b9.gif[/img]

[b]Skip that dab[/b]
You told us, we heard you. You can now skip the dab animation between levels using the right trigger button or left-mouse button and jump to the next level.

Play it now!

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New surrounding environments and floors added to all levels
[*] Death camera
[*] Skip dab animation between levels
[*] Bolt migration, code is more robust and resilient
[*] Improved config and save/load
[*] Audio pooling
[*] Menu improvements
[*] Breakable walls' debris disappears
[/list]

[b]Lucky Me localization[/b]
Artifact 5 is based in Montréal – home to poutine and the underground city – which means that our team is composed of both English and French speakers. The game is initially available in these two languages, and more will come as we pursue development. Let us know which languages you would like to see in the game.
